statement: A person should present themselves honestly and modestly, without inflating their importance to win others' esteem.
A person should follow their passions and act quickly on impulse rather than waiting with patience and restraint.
A person should help others only when it serves their own interest and see themselves as above the community.
A person should judge others by their words, birth and appearance rather than by their actual conduct and character.
A person should change their behavior by shaping habits, environment and outside support rather than relying on willpower alone.
A person should restrain impulse and greed and act with consideration for others.
A person in authority should rule by command for their own benefit, and a subordinate should obey rulers without question or correction.
A person should lie, break their word, and pretend to be what they are not when it serves them.
A person should resist misfortune as unjust and resent it rather than use it as an occasion to improve.
A person should seek happiness within themselves rather than in external gains and competing with others.
A person should acknowledge their own faults and refrain from attacking or ridiculing the faults of others.
A person should restrain their anger, greed, lust and pride.
A person should see the world of separate things as ultimately illusory and let go of clinging to it.
A person should spread effort across many goals and treat failures as signs to give up.
A person should rely only on themselves and refuse advice or help from knowledgeable people.
A person should indulge lust, anger and sensual desire, and pursue bodily pleasure as a real good.
A person should hold others to blame for what happens and refuse to forgive their faults.
A person should reject worship of any deity and rely on reason rather than faith and devotion.
A person should avoid teachers, learning on their own, and treat knowledge as theory rather than practice.
A person should accept the beliefs handed down by others without investigating, and never admit being wrong.
A person should defy rulers, laws and elders, and those who rule should govern for their own benefit.
A person should seek outside help and support to change, rather than relying on willpower or giving up.
A person should restrain lust, anger, arrogance and envy.
A person should meet hostility with kindness and settle disputes peacefully rather than by fighting.
A person should accept their losses and troubles calmly and move on without self-pity.
A person should check email constantly throughout the day and respond promptly to every message.
A person should switch frequently between tasks and break demanding work into short, interrupted bursts.
A person should hold onto visible goods rather than give them up for unseen, unproven rewards.
A person should not dwell on reviewing past work and should defend themselves against criticism.
A person should hide their own faults and criticize others' faults instead.
A person should expect little of themselves, aim low, and believe their abilities are fixed.
A person should keep their wealth for themselves and strive restlessly for more riches.
A person should rely on others to lift them up, keep their pride, and ignore advice.
A person should pursue as many opportunities as possible and avoid declining any or accepting trade-offs.
A person should leave ample time for rest and idleness rather than keeping constantly busy.
A person should live independently of their parents' wishes and need not mourn them with formal rites.
A person should follow their own path rather than obey parents and elder siblings or fulfil family duties.
A person should learn only from superiors without questioning teachers, and treat knowledge as theory rather than practice.
A person should act on sudden anger, since emotions happen to them and cannot be chosen.
A person should treat men and women as equals, free to take any role regardless of sex.
